native_form_countercase.type: Post-design manual necessary-form check against already known exact whole forms; not a preregistered discovery or new corpus fit
native_form_countercase.frozen_rule: Every q starts exactly qo+one selector; allowed selectors a,o,e,y,i,n,d,s. Ordinary lexical syllables and name data cannot contain q. Unused selectors are explicitly illegal.
native_form_countercase.argument: Each begins q-o-k. k is not a licensed control selector, so none can be emitted under the frozen control table in any grammar/name state or learned lexical extension. Continuation cannot split a control atom. Adding meanings to ordinary roots cannot change this.
native_form_countercase.owned_locus_example: GDT1204 retains qokeedy chey qokeey at f108v.35 in ZL/IT and the same literal RF triple, with qokeedy/chedy/qokeey at .52 for ZL/IT; RF .52 entities retained. GDT1205qualitative photograph support is not exact independent letter certification.
native_form_countercase.meaning_limit: No native form receives the teaching control or vocabulary meaning. This is an incompatibility of the proposed fixed physical syntax, not a translation.

shape_positives_and_limits: The open inventory has21possible ordinary final and medial signs, so1193three-medial and1224six-final bounds are not universal bounds on this script. Its seven taught entries do not instantiate all native forms.
The source-held message uses identical short person terms twice without a repeat header. This is legal role filling, not a native reduplication interpretation.
The q/o design alone fails to support the very common qok shapes under its actual control selectors. q/o adjacency is not sufficient evidence for the control mechanism.
The3form aggregate is a lower bound for this named counterexample set, not a complete script failure census or an estimated error rate. Alternative readings remain separate.

decision: Retain the successful physical teaching readback; stop this unchanged fixed-q-control writer as a native candidate before any large source/statistical implementation. No new k selector, glyph remapping, exception inventory or corpus adaptation is selected.
